recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel vertical triptych composition featuring a central high-contrast monochrome portrait of two men in profile, flanked by two textured, mauve-toned side panels containing decorative typography and a calligraphic monogram.
coreVisualRelationships: Central high-contrast photographic strip versus muted textured side panels
Overlapping profile portraits creating depth and unity
Tall, narrow display type spanning the top width of the composition
Ornate script monogram balancing the geometric rigidity of the panels
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for the central subject
Speckled, recycled-paper texture on the outer panels
Muted mauve or dusty rose color palette for the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two men in profile facing right, positioned in the lower two-thirds of the central vertical column.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp profile of the foremost man's face in the center panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large display text at the top, move down the central portrait, and settle on the secondary text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the side panels to allow for texture and graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black and Stark White (central portrait)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the central photographic element.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and desaturated purples

letterConstructionRules: Display type is extremely tall and narrow with sharp serifs
Monogram is composed of thick and thin calligraphic flourishes
Body text is small, wide-tracked, and elegant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated vertical stems on the top display text
Interlocking flourishes on the monogram logo
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, vertical condensed serifs and fluid, organic script flourishes.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadow on the central panel

preserve: Wide tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif style of the top text.
Provides the wide-tracked, small-cap elegance required for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical triptych. The center panel is a high-contrast black and white profile photo of two men. The side panels are a dusty mauve color with a heavy recycled paper texture (specks and fibers).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place ultra-condensed serif text across the top in a copper tone. Add a large, white, semi-transparent calligraphic monogram in the top right panel. Place small, wide-tracked serif text in the bottom left of the center panel.

verificationChecks: Is the central image high-contrast monochrome?
Are the side panels textured and mauve?
Is the top text extremely tall and narrow?
Is the layout divided into three vertical sections?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the subjects' faces.
Verify the paper texture is visible but not distracting.
Check that the copper text is legible against the background.
Confirm the triptych lines are perfectly vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Triptych + High-Contrast Portrait + Textured Earth-Tone Panels + Condensed Serif Typography
